records.translation: Hospital_Ambient/20 5/farmer 20 12 0 Pierre 14 15 0/skippable/doAction 20 11/move farmer 0 -7 1/move farmer -1 0 0/move farmer 0 -1 0/pause 600/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 1000/showFrame 35/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/playSound secret1/stopAnimation farmer/message "發現了皮耶的「祕密收藏」。"/pause 1000/speak Pierre "嘿！誰在臥室裡？$4"/warp Pierre 20 12 true/faceDirection Pierre 0/playMusic ragtime/move Pierre 0 -4 0 true/faceDirection farmer 2 true/showFrame 94/jump farmer/pause 1000/stopAnimation farmer/proceedPosition Pierre/emote Pierre 16/speed Pierre 4/move Pierre 0 -3 1 false/move Pierre -1 0 0/faceDirection farmer 2/speak Pierre "什……？你怎麼找到的？！$4"/faceDirection Pierre 2/pause 200/faceDirection Pierre 0/speak Pierre "快點，還給我！$u"/showFrame 95/pause 300/playSound coin/pause 600/showFrame 0/pause 500/speak Pierre "$q 50 null#答應我不會把這件事告訴任何人。#$r 50 70 Event_naga1#我會替你保密。#$r 50 -500 Event_naga2#你妻子有權知道這件事。"/pause 500/speed Pierre 2/move Pierre 1 0 2/emote Pierre 12/speak Pierre "*嘟囔*……現在又得找新的藏匿地點……*嘟囔*$u"/move Pierre 0 8 0 true/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

pause 500/updateMinigame 6/resetVariable/playMusic Lava_Ambient/pause 1600/message "薩斯：入侵者？竟敢闖進我的私人房間！"/pause 800/message "啊，原來你們是為了索拉里昂法杖而來……"/pause 800/message "嘿嘿嘿……蠢貨。你們會成為我骷髏大軍的優秀新兵！"/pause 500/fork choseWizard finalBossWizard/fork choseWarrior finalBossWarrior/message "恐懼領主薩斯施放暗影光束！"/pause 500/playSound flameSpell/pause 800/playSound flameSpellHit/updateMinigame -1/pause 1000/message "你躲開了法術，但同伴全都身受重傷！"/pause 500/question fork0 "你要怎麼做？#治療戰士（山姆）。#治療法師（塞巴斯蒂安）。"/pause 500/fork healedSam/playSound healSound/pause 500/speak Sebastian "謝了，@。$7"/speak Sam "……$s"/pause 1000/playMusic none/message "塞巴斯蒂安施放「純淨箭」……一道白光正中薩斯的臉。恐懼領主尖叫著化為塵土。"/playSound debuffSpell/pause 500/playSound killAnimal/updateMinigame 9/updateMinigame -1/pause 800/message "你拾起索拉里昂法杖，高舉過頭。世界恢復了秩序。"/addMailReceived savedFriends/pause 1000/playSound getNewSpecialItem/updateMinigame -2/switchEvent end

continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Marlon 66 15 2/broadcastEvent/skippable/pause 1000/move farmer -1 0 2/move farmer 0 1 1/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 1000/speak Marlon "今天早上碰見羅賓……她說你蓋了一間新的史萊姆屋！"/showFrame Marlon 8/shake Marlon 1600/textAboveHead Marlon "不賴！"/pause 1600/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 500/speak Marlon "我像你這麼大時也迷過繁殖史萊姆。這是很棒的嗜好……但也很危險。#$b#你以為我這隻眼睛是怎麼沒的？"/shake Marlon 1000/showFrame Marlon 12/textAboveHead Marlon "哈！"/pause 1000/textAboveHead Marlon "開玩笑的。"/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 200/showFrame Marlon 7/animate Marlon false false 120 4 5 6 7/pause 800/speak Marlon "來，我有樣東西要給你。"/faceDirection farmer 2/itemAboveHead slimeEgg/pause 1000/pause 1000/pause 1300/awardFestivalPrize slimeEgg/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 1 true/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 12/speak Marlon "這是史萊姆蛋。把它放進史萊姆孵化器就能孵出史萊姆。#$b#現在，仔細看看這顆蛋。下次出門獵史萊姆時，多留意有沒有其他蛋。雖然很稀有，但史萊姆偶爾會掉落。#$b#收集不同史萊姆的蛋，讓你的族群更多樣化！"/pause 500/end

pause 200/pause 500/faceDirection Pam 2/showFrame Pam 25/pause 250/faceDirection Penny 2/speak Pam "那我……只好放下自尊了……"/pause 500/speak Pam "*清喉嚨*……謝謝你，@。$s"/pause 500/speak Penny "媽媽……$s"/faceDirection Pam 0/speak Penny "別擔心……@只是想讓我們開心。鵜鶘鎮裡沒有人會因為我們窮就瞧不起我們。$s"/faceDirection Robin 1/pause 500/speak Pam "……我們已經不「窮」了，孩子……別再這麼想！#$b#從現在開始，我們會像真正的一家人……聽見了嗎？#$b#我不想一直這麼怨天尤人了……$s#$b#我要努力改變自己的人生……"/emote Penny 20/pause 100/animate Penny false true 200 0 1 2 3/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 500/positionOffset Penny 0 8/animate Penny false true 100 39/warp Pam -100 -100/playSound coin/pause 3000/fade/viewport -2000 -2000/pause 400/playMusic none/pause 1000/end

WizardSong/2 14/farmer 3 14 3 Wizard 1 14 1/skippable/pause 1000/speak Wizard "你找到我的墨水了！太好了。"/move Wizard 1 0 1/pause 1000/speak Wizard "呃……"/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 18/pause 500/speak Wizard "你……碰巧見到我前妻了嗎？#$b#沒有？那她的房子呢……？#$b#你覺得她獨自生活嗎？還是……$h"/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 0/emote Wizard 12/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 3/pause 500/speak Wizard "……其實別告訴我……我不想知道。"/pause 500/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 500/speak Wizard "總之……你一定想知道獎勵是什麼。來……"/move Wizard -1 0 1/pause 800/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 1000/showFrame Wizard 16/pause 800/specificTemporarySprite arcaneBook/playSound fireball/shake Wizard 500/pause 4000/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Wizard 1/faceDirection Wizard 0/pause 500/speak Wizard "這是一本召喚之書。#$b#它蘊含極大的奧術潛力……但我會替你化繁為簡。#$b#使用這本書，就能直接在農場召喚魔法建築。#$b#我想你會覺得它很有用。"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 3/faceDirection Wizard 1/speak Wizard "哦，我差點忘了說……咳嗯……謝謝你。"/pause 1000/emote farmer 32/pause 800/end

pause 200/pause 500/faceDirection Pam 2/showFrame Pam 25/pause 250/faceDirection Penny 2/speak Pam "那我……只好放下自尊了……"/pause 500/speak Pam "*清喉嚨*……謝謝你，@。$s"/pause 500/speak Penny "媽媽……$s"/faceDirection Pam 0/speak Penny "別擔心，媽媽……我們只是想讓你開心。鵜鶘鎮裡沒有人會因為我們窮就瞧不起我們。$s"/faceDirection Robin 1/pause 500/speak Pam "……我已經不「窮」了，孩子……別再這麼想！#$b#從現在開始，我們會像真正的一家人……聽見了嗎？#$b#我不想一直這麼怨天尤人了……$s#$b#我要努力改變自己的人生……"/emote Penny 20/pause 100/animate Penny false true 200 0 1 2 3/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 500/positionOffset Penny 0 8/animate Penny false true 100 39/warp Pam -100 -100/playSound coin/pause 3000/fade/viewport -2000 -2000/pause 400/playMusic none/pause 1000/end

nightTime/-1000 -1000/farmer 33 18 2 Shane 34 25 2/skippable/addLantern 735 35 25 1/animate Shane false true 200 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 21 22 23 24 24 24 24 23 22 21 20 20 20 20/viewport 34 25 true/move farmer 0 7 2/pause 2000/speak Shane "這麼晚還沒睡，嗯？"/stopAnimation Shane/showFrame Shane 20/pause 1000/speak Shane "來，喝罐冰的。"/pause 500/showFrame Shane 25/pause 1000/playSound coin/showFrame 90/stopAnimation Shane/showFrame Shane 20/pause 5000/showFrame Shane 20/speak Shane "呃……人生啊。"/playMusic echos/pause 4000/speak Shane "你有沒有覺得……無論做什麼，最後都會失敗？#$b#……就像困在悲慘的深淵裡，而且陷得太深，連日光都看不見？"/pause 2000/speak Shane "我只是覺得，無論多麼努力……自己都不夠強壯，爬不出那個洞。"/pause 3000/farmerEat 346/pause 4000/speak Shane "嘿……喝得很快嘛？真是我的好兄弟。^嘿……喝得很快嘛？真是我的好姊妹。#$b#只是別養成習慣……你的未來還長。"/pause 3000/stopAnimation Shane/showFrame Shane 19/speak Shane "好啦……我的肝在求我停手。今晚就到這裡吧。#$b#改天見，@。"/move Shane 0 -6 0 true/pause 1000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

jaunty/-1000 -1000/farmer 10 10 0 Alex 13 6 2/skippable/showFrame Alex 28/animate Alex false true 100 28 29 30 31 32 32 31 30 29 28/viewport 13 6 true/pause 6500/stopAnimation Alex/pause 1000/doAction 10 9/move farmer 0 -3 1/move farmer 2 0 0/showFrame Alex 34 true/animate Alex false false 100 28 33 34/pause 600/speak Alex "哦！嘿……我只是在做每日的肌力訓練。$6#$b#……抱歉，我沒穿上衣。$6"/pause 1000/emote Alex 40/speak Alex "呃……@？我一直想跟你談件事……$8"/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/speak Alex "我開始發現……嗯，自己以前對你真的很無禮。你知道，就是關於成為職業選手那些事。$8"/pause 1000/showFrame Alex 33/pause 1000/speak Alex "我想自己也許真的不適合職業運動……或許那只是個孩子氣的夢想……你懂吧？$8#$b#總之……我想為之前一直吹噓和煩你而道歉。謝謝你經歷那些事後仍然把我當朋友。$6"/move farmer 1 0 0/pause 1000/jump farmer/pause 800/showFrame Alex 34/pause 800/emote Alex 32/pause 1200/showFrame Alex 29/pause 100/showFrame Alex 28/pause 100/showFrame Alex 29/pause 100/animate Alex false true 50 30 31 32 32 31 30/pause 3000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

breezy/-1000 -1000/farmer 7 9 0 Leah 12 10 2/skippable/specificTemporarySprite leahLaptop/showFrame Leah 28/positionOffset Leah 0 12/viewport 11 9/move farmer 0 -1 1/move farmer 4 0 2/showFrame Leah 29/speak Leah "嘿！過來看看這個。"/pause 500/showFrame Leah 28/move farmer 0 2 2/pause 400/speak Leah "我照你的建議買了筆記型電腦，還開了一間線上藝術商店……"/pause 800/playSound Pickup_Coin15/showFrame Leah 29/pause 400/speak Leah "聽見了嗎？那表示剛才有人從店裡買了東西！$h"/showFrame Leah 28/emote Leah 40/speak Leah "嗯……有位「K先生」一直買我的所有雕塑。$7#$b#我猜他一定是某個很喜歡我作品的有錢人。"/pause 500/playSound Pickup_Coin15/pause 300/emote Leah 16/speak Leah "哇！有了這筆銷售收入，我好一陣子都不必擔心電費了……$6"/pause 800/showFrame Leah 29/speak Leah "總之……謝謝你提出這個點子，@。到目前為止非常成功！這真的會提供我繼續全職創作藝術所需的資金。$h"/showFrame Leah 28/speak Leah "好了，抱歉先不理你……但我真的得調整一下這些CSS樣式表……$7"/pause 500/playSound Pickup_Coin15/pause 1000/playSound Pickup_Coin15/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end warpOut

spring_day_ambient/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Willy 64 18 0/skippable/pause 1500/speak Willy "早安，小伙子！^早安，小姐！"/pause 800/speak Willy "抱歉這麼早打擾你，但，呃……我注意到你最近不太釣魚。"/pause 200/emote farmer 28/pause 200/speak Willy "是啊……對初學者來說，這項運動可能很難上手。"/pause 400/speak Willy "所以我想給你幾個要領……也許能幫你練出水手的本事！"/pause 500/playMusic distantBanjo/pause 500/speak Willy "你看，釣竿要像這樣握……"/pause 300/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 1000/message "威利快速教了你一堂釣魚基礎課。"/gainSkill Fishing 1/pause 500/message "你已經更有信心了！"/pause 400/viewport 64 15 clamp true/pause 1000/speak Willy "還有一件事……我想把這個送給你。#$b#這叫作「訓練用釣竿」。應該能讓你更容易釣到魚。#$b#只是要注意，用它只能釣到基本的魚。不過這是初期磨練技巧的好方法！"/pause 800/itemAboveHead (T)TrainingRod/pause 3300/awardFestivalPrize (T)TrainingRod/pause 200/pause 500/speak Willy "希望你會再試試釣魚。一旦掌握訣竅，就會玩得很開心。#$b#祝你好運！$h"/pause 1000/end

jaunty/-1000 -1000/farmer 1 1 2 Sebastian 5 9 3 Sam 3 7 2/skippable/showFrame Sam 24/showFrame Sebastian 28/doAction 1 3/viewport 5 5 true/move farmer 0 6 1/pause 500/showFrame Sebastian 29/pause 500/speak Sebastian "嘿，@。$7"/pause 500/speak Sebastian "山姆和我正要玩「索拉里昂編年史：桌上遊戲」……要不要加入？反正三個人玩比較好。$7"/move farmer 0 1 2/pause 500/playSound thudStep/faceDirection farmer 1 true/showFrame 117/positionOffset farmer 16 80/pause 600/speak Sebastian "好，開始吧……讓我抽劇本卡。$7"/pause 900/showFrame Sebastian 30/playSound dwoop/pause 500/showFrame Sebastian 28/pause 500/speak Sebastian "嗯……看來今天的任務會帶我們進入死靈法師之塔……試著從恐懼領主薩斯的魔掌中奪回索拉里昂法杖。"/pause 600/speak Sam "酷……@，準備好選角色了嗎？"/pause 500/question chooseCharacter "選擇角色：#戰士。我喜歡直接了當。#治療者。我比較喜歡幫助別人。#法師。敏銳的心智才是最強的利刃。"/pause 500/speak Sebastian "嘿！我本來要選那個！$h#$b#那我就當治療者吧。"/pause 500/speak Sam "酷。反正戰士才是我的最愛。"/addMailReceived choseWizard/switchEvent opening

sweet/-1000 -1000/farmer 53 34 0/broadcastEvent/addTemporaryActor Morris 16 32 -100 -100 2 true/pause 500/speak Morris "各位，他來了！打起精神！^各位，她來了！打起精神！"/specificTemporarySprite jojaCeremony/viewport 53 14 true/viewport move 0 1 8000/pause 9000/move farmer 0 -10 0/pause 4000/speak Morris "*清喉嚨*……"/pause 500/speak Morris "就在短短幾年前，Joja總部的偉大創新人才想到一個新點子：Joja社區發展計畫。#$b#這項計畫的構想，是為我們珍愛的社區提供重要建設服務……*吸鼻子*……同時創造可觀的營收！#$b#基礎設施殘破的鵜鶘鎮正是完美的試驗場。"/pause 500/speak Morris "多虧了你，我們的社區發展試辦計畫取得了重大成功！#$b#從修復老橋、修好公車，到把瓦礫堆變成溫室，我們真的讓這座城鎮煥然一新！#$b#而且我也大大升職了！嘿嘿嘿。"/pause 1000/speak Morris "公司總裁請我把這份獨家禮物送給你，向你表達「謝意」。"/playMusic none/pause 1000/awardFestivalPrize joja/null/itemAboveHead joja/null/pause 1000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end Position 52 27/end

pause 400/emote Penny 40/speak Penny "好了，今天大概就到這裡。你們兩個去玩吧。"/speed Jas 4/move Jas 0 3 1/speed Jas 4/move Jas 9 0 3 true/faceDirection Vincent 2 true/jump Vincent/pause 800/speed Vincent 4/move Vincent 0 3 1 false/speed Vincent 4/move Vincent 9 0 1/pause 500/faceDirection Vincent 2/faceDirection Jas 2/faceDirection Penny 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Penny "照顧這些孩子真的很辛苦……$u#$b#不過我不太介意。我喜歡看著他們學習……也希望自己能幫助他們長大成為善良的人。"/faceDirection Penny 2/pause 500/faceDirection Penny 1/speak Penny "$q -1 null#@，你有想過當父母嗎？#$r -1 0 event_speaker_kids1#我還沒認真想過。#$r -1 20 event_speaker_kids2#當然。我想要一個大家庭。#$r -1 20 event_speaker_kids3#應該會吧。這是自然的渴望。#$r -1 10 event_speaker_kids4#不，我覺得自己不會擅長。#$r -1 -10 event_speaker_kids5#不，世界已經夠擁擠了。#$r -1 -10 event_speaker_kids6#不，我不想被家庭束縛。"/viewport move 1 0 10000/pause 7000/stopMusic/globalFade/viewport -2000 -2000/speak Penny "很高興你出現了，@。我想孩子們都玩得很開心。$h"/end dialogue Penny "謝謝你讓我今天的校外教學圓滿成功。"

pause 10/message "凱爾：我跟你沒什麼好說的。讓開。"/speed farmer 2/move farmer 1 0 3/move LeahEx 0 2 2/message "凱爾：說真的，莉亞……你和這個頭腦簡單的鄉巴佬待在這裡做什麼？"/faceDirection farmer 2/showFrame Leah 26/pause 1000/showFrame Leah 27/showFrame 94/playSound clubhit/screenFlash .25/showFrame LeahEx 6/jump LeahEx/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset farmer 0 8/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/positionOffset LeahEx 0 -4/pause 25/pause 200/playSound clubSmash/showFrame LeahEx 7/shake LeahEx 1000/stopAnimation farmer/speak Leah "@各方面都比你更像個${man^person}$！$a#$b#現在滾出去，永遠別再回來！$a"/move Leah -1 0 0/move Leah 0 -4 1/speak Leah "走吧，@。凱爾應該不會再打擾我們了。"/move farmer 0 1 2/faceDirection Leah 2 true/move farmer -2 0 0/move Leah 0 -11 0 true/move farmer 0 -11 0 true/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 1000/speak Leah "這次找個更隱密的地方吧……$l"/playMusic none/pause 2000/end dialogue Leah "嗯，野餐沒有像我希望的那樣順利。$h"

libraryTheme/29 12/farmer 22 13 1 Gunther 31 12 2/removeQuest 23/addQuest 24/skippable/pause 1000/showFrame Gunther 4/pause 500/showFrame Gunther 0/pause 500/showFrame Gunther 12/pause 500/showFrame Gunther 0/pause 1000/showFrame Gunther 1/pause 500/speak Gunther "慘不忍睹……#$b#整批館藏裡一件展品都沒有。"/move farmer 7 0 1/showFrame Gunther 12/pause 800/emote Gunther 16/jump Gunther/pause 800/speak Gunther "這是什麼？你找到東西了？讓我看看！"/move farmer 0 -1 1/move farmer 1 0 1/pause 500/playSound coin/animate Gunther false true 500 2 3/pause 3000/speak Gunther "太了不起了！#$b#這件東西非常古老。#$b#我很想仔細研究……但它是你的。"/stopAnimation Gunther/showFrame Gunther 12/pause 1000/speak Gunther "嗯……#$b#我想請你幫個忙。#$b#你願意考慮把新發現的古物或礦物捐出來嗎？#$b#我們可以一起完成突破性的發現！#$b#哦，誰知道呢……只要繼續捐贈，我或許會遇到一些有趣的物品，可以送給你。"/pause 1000/showFrame Gunther 0/pause 500/speak Gunther "考慮一下，好嗎？#$b#如果決定捐贈，把物品帶到櫃檯就行。"/move farmer -3 0 2 true/pause 400/showFrame Gunther 1/proceedPosition farmer/move farmer 0 1 3/move farmer -7 0 3 true/pause 1000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end
